name: Trade Receivables
description: Amounts owed to the company from customers and business partners in the normal course of operations (e.g. outstanding invoices to guests or hosts).

name: Other Receivables
description: Non-trade amounts owed to the company such as staff advances and other miscellaneous receivables not related to core business operations.

name: Prepayments
description: Payments made in advance for goods or services not yet received (e.g. prepaid rent or prepaid insurance premiums covering future periods).

name: Customer Deposits
description: Refundable deposits paid by the company to third parties (e.g. office rental deposits or security deposits).

name: Loans to Others
description: Short-term loans extended to individuals or entities outside the group. Tracks principal amounts outstanding.

name: Currency Exchange
description: Temporary clearing account for foreign currency conversion transactions. Should net to zero after conversions are completed.

name: GST Receivable (Input Tax)
description: GST/VAT paid on business purchases that is reclaimable from the tax authority (IRAS for Singapore, ATO for Australia). Offset against GST Payable when filing returns.

name: Computer & Peripherals
description: Laptops, desktops, monitors, and peripheral equipment purchased for business use. Capitalised at cost and depreciated over useful life.

name: Hardware Devices
description: In-car GPS/telematics devices purchased for installation in host vehicles. Includes devices in stock and installed. Capitalised at cost, depreciated over useful life.

name: Motor Vehicles
description: Motor vehicles owned by the company (e.g. RMS fleet vehicles). Capitalised at purchase cost and depreciated over useful life.

name: Furniture & Fixtures
description: Office desks, chairs, shelving, and other fixtures. Capitalised at cost and depreciated over useful life.

name: Accum Depr - Computer & Peripherals
description: Cumulative depreciation charged against Computer & Peripherals (1500). Contra-asset that reduces the net book value on the balance sheet.

name: Accum Depr - Hardware Devices
description: Cumulative depreciation charged against Hardware Devices (1510). Contra-asset that reduces the net book value on the balance sheet.

name: Accum Depr - Motor Vehicles
description: Cumulative depreciation charged against Motor Vehicles (1520). Contra-asset that reduces the net book value on the balance sheet.

name: Accum Depr - Furniture & Fixtures
description: Cumulative depreciation charged against Furniture & Fixtures (1530). Contra-asset that reduces the net book value on the balance sheet.

name: Brand
description: Capitalised costs related to brand development, trademark registration, and brand identity. Amortised over useful life.

name: Technology Development
description: Capitalised software development costs (platform, mobile app, internal tools). Amortised over useful life once the asset is available for use.

name: Accum Amort - Brand
description: Cumulative amortisation charged against Brand (1700). Contra-asset that reduces the net book value on the balance sheet.

name: Accum Amort - Technology Development
description: Cumulative amortisation charged against Technology Development (1710). Contra-asset that reduces the net book value on the balance sheet.

name: Allowance for Doubtful Accounts
description: Provision for receivables that may not be collected (bad debt reserve). Contra-asset that reduces the net receivables on the balance sheet.

name: Trade & Other Payables
description: Amounts owed to suppliers and vendors for goods and services received in the normal course of business (e.g. workshop invoices or software vendor bills).

name: Other Payables
description: Non-trade amounts owed such as statutory payments due or miscellaneous liabilities not related to regular supplier invoices.

name: Deferred Trip Revenue
description: Trip booking payments collected from guests but not yet earned (trip hasn't started or completed). Recognised as revenue (4000-4003) when trip is fulfilled, or refunded (5052) if cancelled.

name: Customer Deposits Held
description: Security or verification deposits collected from guests and held until the trip is completed. Returned to guest after trip, or applied against damage/incidental charges.

name: Host Payables
description: Amounts owed to car owners (hosts) for their earnings share from completed trips. Settled via periodic payouts from the payment platform.

name: Host Payouts - Flex+
description: Host's earnings share from Flex+ long-term bookings. Paid monthly to the car owner based on the long-term rental agreement terms.

name: Accrued Expenses
description: Expenses that have been incurred but not yet invoiced or paid (e.g. electricity used in January, bill arrives February; salary for last week of month paid next month). Ensures expenses are recorded in the correct period.

name: Deferred Income
description: Cash received for services not yet delivered (e.g. annual device subscription paid upfront). Revenue is recognised monthly as service is delivered, reducing this liability over time.

name: CPF Payable (SG)
description: Singapore Central Provident Fund contributions withheld from employees (employee share) plus employer's contribution, owed to the CPF Board. Settled monthly.

name: PAYG Withholding Payable (AU)
description: Australian Pay As You Go tax withheld from employee wages on behalf of the ATO. Settled quarterly via Business Activity Statement (BAS).

name: Superannuation Payable (AU)
description: Australian employer superannuation guarantee contributions owed to employee super funds. Currently 11.5% of ordinary time earnings. Settled quarterly.

name: Employee Claims Payable
description: Approved employee expense reimbursement claims awaiting payment. When approved, the expense is recorded (6010-6014) and this liability is created. Cleared when payment is made.

name: Salaries Payable
description: Staff salaries that have been earned/accrued but not yet paid (e.g. month-end accrual before payday). Cleared on pay date.

name: Loans from Others
description: Loans received from external parties (individuals or institutions). Tracks principal amounts outstanding.

name: GST Payable (Output Tax)
description: GST/VAT collected on sales that is owed to the tax authority (IRAS for Singapore, ATO for Australia). Net of GST Receivable (1350) determines amount payable/refundable on GST return.

name: Share Capital
description: Total capital invested by shareholders in exchange for ownership shares. Represents the par value of issued shares plus any share premium.

name: Retained Earnings
description: Cumulative net profits (or losses) from all prior periods that have not been distributed as dividends. Automatically updated at year-end close.

name: Opening Balance Equity
description: Temporary account used during system migration to capture opening balances from the legacy system (QuickBooks). Should be zero after migration is complete.

name: Suspense Account
description: Temporary holding account for transactions that cannot be immediately classified. All items should be investigated and reclassified to proper accounts promptly.

name: GBV - P2P
description: Gross Booking Value from peer-to-peer short-term car rentals (non-managed). This is the total amount charged to the guest, before deducting host payouts and platform fees.

name: GBV - P2P RMS
description: Gross Booking Value from short-term rentals on cars managed under the Rental Management Service. Higher platform margin than P2P due to management fee (approx 10% extra).

name: GBV - Flex+
description: Gross Booking Value from long-term car rentals (Flex+ product, non-managed). Typically monthly or multi-month bookings.

name: GBV - Flex+ RMS
description: Gross Booking Value from long-term rentals on RMS-managed cars. Combines long-term rental revenue with rental management service margin.

name: Subscription Revenue - Device
description: Monthly or annual fees charged to hosts for the in-car telematics/GPS device subscription. Recognised as service is delivered.

name: Subscription Revenue - Insurance
description: Fees charged to hosts for optional insurance subscription products. Recognised as the insurance coverage period elapses.

name: Incidentals Revenue - Tolls
description: Toll charges billed to guests or recovered from hosts for tolls incurred during a trip. Drive Lah may retain a margin.

name: Incidentals Revenue - Damage
description: Damage fees charged to guests for vehicle damage during a trip. Separate from insurance recovery (4030) which comes from insurers.

name: Incidentals Revenue - Cleaning
description: Cleaning fees charged to guests when a vehicle is returned in an unacceptable condition. Paid to cleaning provider via 5022.

name: Incidentals Revenue - Fuel
description: Fuel charges billed when a guest returns a vehicle with less fuel than at pickup. Host or guest is charged; guest may be refunded.

name: Incidentals Revenue - Excess Mileage
description: Charges for kilometres driven beyond the included allowance in a booking. Billed to guest and partially passed through to host.

name: Incidentals Revenue - Other
description: Catch-all for incidental charges that do not fall into the specific categories above (e.g. late return fees charged to guests).

name: Insurance Recoveries
description: Claim proceeds received from insurance companies for damage to vehicles. Separate from damage charged to guests (4021). Recorded as revenue when claim is approved and received.

name: Host Payouts - P2P
description: Host's earnings share from P2P short-term bookings. Typically ~60% of GBV. This is the largest single cost component, paid to the car owner after trip completion.

name: Host Payouts - P2P RMS
description: Host's earnings share from P2P RMS bookings. Typically ~50% of GBV (lower than P2P regular due to 10% management fee). Paid to car owner after trip completion.

name: Host Payouts - Flex+ RMS
description: Host's earnings share from Flex+ RMS bookings. Lower payout percentage than Flex+ regular due to the management fee component.

name: Payment Processing Fees
description: Fees charged by payment processors (e.g. Stripe) for processing guest payments, host payouts, and refunds. Typically 2-3% of transaction value.

name: Incidentals Payout - Tolls
description: Toll charges reimbursed to hosts or paid to toll operators. The difference between toll revenue (4020) and this payout is the platform margin.

name: Incidentals Payout - Damage (Host)
description: Compensation paid to hosts for vehicle damage caused by guests during a trip. Separate from workshop (5032) and insurance excess (5036) costs.

name: Incidentals Payout - Cleaning
description: Payments to hosts or cleaning service providers for vehicle cleaning after a trip. Funded by cleaning charges to guests (4022).

name: Incidentals Payout - Fuel
description: Fuel cost refunds paid to guests who filled fuel that the host should have provided. Recovered from host charges.

name: Incidentals Payout - Excess Mileage
description: Excess mileage compensation paid to hosts for additional wear on their vehicle. Funded by excess mileage charges to guests (4024).

name: Incidentals Payout - Other
description: Catch-all for miscellaneous incidental payouts to hosts or third parties not covered by specific incidental categories.

name: Cost of Device Subscriptions
description: Direct costs of providing the device subscription product: hardware purchase cost, SIM/data connectivity, and device maintenance. Matched against device subscription revenue (4010).

name: Cost of Insurance - Subscription Premium
description: Insurance premiums paid to the insurer for providing the host insurance subscription product. Matched against insurance subscription revenue (4011).

name: Incidentals Payout - Workshop
description: Payments to workshops and repair centres for vehicle damage repairs. Part of the total damage cost alongside host compensation (5021) and assessor fees (5034).

name: Incidentals Payout - Towing
description: Payments to towing companies for vehicle recovery after breakdowns or accidents. May be partially recovered through insurance claims (4030).

name: Incidentals Payout - Assessor
description: Fees paid to damage assessors for inspecting and reporting on vehicle damage. Required for insurance claims and dispute resolution.

name: Cost of Insurance - Trip Premium
description: Insurance premium paid per trip to provide coverage for all bookings. This is a cost of doing business that applies across P2P/RMS/Flex+ equally.

name: Cost of Insurance - Excess/Deductible
description: Insurance excess (deductible) amount paid to the insurer when making a damage claim. The portion of the claim the company must bear before insurance covers the rest.

name: Host Payouts - Superhost
description: Bonus payments to hosts who achieve Superhost status based on ratings and performance metrics. An incentive program cost.

name: Host Payouts - Sticker
description: Payments to hosts who display Drive Lah branding stickers on their vehicles. A marketing-related host incentive.

name: Host Payouts - Misc
description: Miscellaneous payments to hosts that do not fit into specific payout categories (e.g. goodwill payments or ad-hoc compensations).

name: Host Payouts - Downtime
description: Compensation paid to hosts when their vehicle is unavailable due to platform-related issues (e.g. repairs from guest damage or operational holds).

name: Host Payouts - Late Return
description: Compensation paid to hosts when a guest returns the vehicle late and the host incurs inconvenience or lost booking opportunity.

name: Monthly Discounts
description: Promotional discounts applied to trip bookings (e.g. first-trip discounts, seasonal promotions, loyalty discounts). Reduces effective revenue.

name: Chargebacks
description: Payment chargebacks initiated by guests through their bank or credit card company. Includes the chargeback amount plus any processor fees.

name: Refunds - Trip
description: Trip booking refunds issued to guests for cancellations, service issues, or disputes. Reduces effective revenue from GBV.

name: Refunds - Incidentals
description: Refunds of incidental charges (tolls/damage/cleaning/fuel/mileage) issued to guests after dispute resolution or reassessment.

name: Refunds - Device Subscription
description: Refunds of device subscription fees to hosts (e.g. for cancellations or service issues with the device).

name: Refunds - Insurance Subscription
description: Refunds of insurance subscription fees to hosts (e.g. for cancellations or policy changes).

name: Parking - RMS Fleet
description: Parking costs for RMS-managed fleet vehicles including monthly parking subscriptions and ad-hoc parking charges.

name: Bank Fees
description: Bank account maintenance fees, transaction fees, wire transfer charges, and other banking service costs.

name: On-Ground Team - Salary
description: Salaries for the on-ground operations team who perform device installations, vehicle relocations, cleaning coordination, workshop runs, and customer handovers.

name: On-Ground Team - Expenses
description: Out-of-pocket expenses incurred by the on-ground team including fuel/mileage reimbursement, parking during tasks, and incidental costs while on the job.

name: Customer Support - Salary
description: Salaries for the customer support team handling guest and host enquiries, trip issues, and dispute resolution.

name: Warehousing Costs
description: Rent and operating costs for the warehouse used to store devices and fleet equipment before deployment.

name: Cost of Device - Installation
description: Labour and material costs for installing in-car devices in host vehicles. Includes technician time, wiring, and mounting hardware.

name: Cost of Device - Courier/Shipping
description: Courier and shipping costs to deliver devices to hosts or installation locations when on-site installation is not possible.

name: Salaries & Wages
description: Gross salaries and wages for corporate/admin staff (tech, product, finance, management). Excludes on-ground team (5061) and customer support (5063) which are COS.

name: Employer CPF (SG)
description: Singapore employer's Central Provident Fund contribution (currently 17% for employees under 55). Statutory cost on top of gross salary, paid to CPF Board monthly.

name: Employer Superannuation (AU)
description: Australian employer superannuation guarantee contribution (currently 11.5%). Statutory cost on top of gross salary, paid to employee's super fund quarterly.

name: Directors Salary
description: Remuneration paid to company directors. Tracked separately from staff salaries for disclosure requirements and corporate governance reporting.

name: Employee Claims - Travel
description: Reimbursements for employee travel expenses (flights, accommodation, transport) incurred for business purposes. Claimed via expense report, held in 2303 until paid.

name: Employee Claims - Meals
description: Reimbursements for employee meal expenses incurred during business travel or client meetings. Subject to company expense policy limits.

name: Employee Claims - Transport
description: Reimbursements for local transport expenses (taxi, ride-share, public transport) incurred for business purposes.

name: Employee Claims - Office Supplies
description: Reimbursements for office supplies purchased by employees on behalf of the company (e.g. stationery or small equipment).

name: Employee Claims - Other
description: Catch-all for employee expense reimbursements that do not fit into specific claim categories above.

name: Marketing - Digital Advertising
description: Spend on digital advertising channels to acquire new guests and hosts (e.g. Google Ads, Facebook Ads, Instagram, TikTok). The primary customer acquisition cost.

name: Marketing - Branding
description: Branding and brand awareness spend including brand campaigns, PR activities, and brand refresh projects. Not direct acquisition.

name: Marketing - Partnerships
description: Costs related to marketing partnerships, co-marketing arrangements, and affiliate programs with external partners.

name: Marketing - Asset Creation
description: Production costs for marketing creative assets: photography, videography, graphic design, and copywriting.

name: Marketing - Agency Fees
description: Fees paid to external marketing agencies for campaign management and marketing strategy services.

name: HR - Recruitment
description: Recruitment costs including agency fees, job board advertising, background checks, and hiring-related expenses.

name: Office Rent
description: Monthly office rental payments. Includes base rent and any common area maintenance charges.

name: Office Equipment
description: Small office equipment purchases below the capitalisation threshold (e.g. keyboards, headsets, cables). Items above threshold go to 1500.

name: Travel - Tickets
description: Business travel flight and rail tickets for staff. Distinct from employee claims (6010) as these may be booked centrally by the company.

name: Travel - Meals
description: Company-paid meals during business travel or team events. Distinct from employee claims (6011) as these may be company-card purchases.

name: Entertainment
description: Client entertainment, team social events, and team-building activities.

name: Accounting & Bookkeeping Fees
description: Fees paid to external accountants, bookkeepers, and audit firms for financial reporting, tax preparation, and compliance services.

name: Legal Fees
description: Fees paid to law firms and legal advisors for corporate legal matters, contract review, disputes, and regulatory compliance.

name: Fines & Penalties
description: Regulatory fines, late payment penalties, and other punitive charges from government bodies or business partners.

name: Technology - Infrastructure
description: Cloud hosting costs (AWS, GCP, etc.), server infrastructure, CDN, database hosting, and DevOps tooling.

name: Technology - Software Subscriptions
description: SaaS subscriptions for business tools (e.g. Slack, Jira, GitHub, analytics platforms, CRM). Monthly or annual licence fees.

name: Depreciation - Computer & Equipment
description: Periodic depreciation expense charged to P&L for Computer & Peripherals (1500). The other side of the entry goes to Accum Depr (1600).

name: Depreciation - In-Car Devices
description: Periodic depreciation expense charged to P&L for Hardware Devices (1510). The other side of the entry goes to Accum Depr (1610).

name: Amortisation - Technology Development
description: Periodic amortisation expense charged to P&L for capitalised Technology Development (1710). The other side of the entry goes to Accum Amort (1810).

name: Amortisation - Brand
description: Periodic amortisation expense charged to P&L for capitalised Brand assets (1700). The other side of the entry goes to Accum Amort (1800).

name: Other Income - Grants
description: Government grants received (e.g. Enterprise Singapore grants, Startup SG, Australian government innovation grants). Recognised when grant conditions are met.

name: Other Income - Cash Rebate
description: Cash rebates received from vendors, banks, or service providers (e.g. corporate card cashback, volume rebates from suppliers).

name: Other Income - Interest
description: Interest earned on bank savings accounts and term deposits. Non-operating income.

name: Foreign Exchange Gains/Losses
description: Realised and unrealised gains or losses from foreign currency transactions and balance sheet translation (e.g. AUD to SGD conversion). Debit for losses, credit for gains.

name: Income Tax Expense
description: Corporate income tax expense for the period (17% for Singapore, 25% for Australia). Calculated on taxable profit after all allowable deductions.
